title: Hi. Is there any plan for Spike (on Ios) to act as Xdrip follower
symptom: User has two Android phones with Xdrip, one as master and one as follower, and wants to know if Spike on iPhone can act as a follower of the master Xdrip. It seems not at the moment, but they ask if there is a workaround.
fix: Currently you gotta make xdrip upload to nightscout, and then use spike as a nightscout follower.
evidence_quote: Currently You gotta make xdrip upload to nightscout, and then use spike as a nightscout follower.
